name: Giggle AI Director
description: 通过 Giggle 生成图片、视频和音频，并把结果保存到 AI Director 画布。
description_zh: 通过 Giggle 生成图片、视频和音频，并把结果保存到 AI Director 画布。
description_en: Generate images, video and audio with Giggle, and save the results to your AI Director canvas.
examples_zh: 查询我可用的模型和当前团队的画布，只查询，不执行生成。
用 Giggle AI Director 在选定画布里画一只坐在霓虹屋顶上的猫，先预估费用。
用 Giggle AI Director 制作一段雨夜城市的短视频，先选一个支持的时长并预估费用。
examples_en: List the available models and the current team's canvases without generating anything.
Draw a cat sitting on a neon-lit rooftop on the selected canvas. Estimate the cost first.
Create a short video of a city on a rainy night. Choose a supported duration and estimate the cost first.
